preconditions.description: The number of data centers is between 2 and 100,000.
The number of clients is between 1 and 100,000.
The day length is between 2 and 100,000.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of data centers to be included in the experiment is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= uj < h for uj in data_center_maintenance_times)
postconditions.description: The maintenance times are within the day length.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci, 1, ci, 2 <= n and ci, 1 != ci, 2 for ci, 1, ci, 2 in client_data_centers)
postconditions.description: The data center indices for each client are valid and different.

postconditions.expression: all(ci, 1 and ci, 2 are available for any hour of the day after the maintenance times are changed)
postconditions.description: The data of each client is available during any hour of the day after the maintenance times are changed.
